plays.rbi_if_error: Rule 9.04(a)(3) cannot apply: it requires fewer than two outs and a runner on third base. Rule 9.04(a)(1) requires the run to be "unaided by an error", so no RBI is credited for this error-dependent run.
plays.rbi_if_hit: A run that scores on a hit is credited an RBI under Rule 9.04(a)(1), subject to the Rule 9.04(b) exceptions and the scorer's judgment; this feed row does not settle any exception.
plays.rbi_if_fc: A run-scoring fielder's choice is one of the plays Rule 9.04(a)(1) lists, so an RBI can be credited, subject to the Rule 9.04(b) exceptions and the scorer's judgment; this feed row does not settle any exception.
